_schema: One record per behaviour-changing operation. Docs-only and test-only commits are excluded -- they are not the denominator. outcome: clean | incomplete | failed_to_fix. injected_defect is independent of outcome (a change can achieve its goal AND break something else). detected_by: pre_commit_check | tests | later_change | paid_run | user. detected_after_ops: how many behaviour-changing operations elapsed before it surfaced (0 = same operation).
_note: Seeded 2026-08-21 from the cost-reduction and rename work. Assessed honestly, including operations that looked correct at commit time and were not.

intent: Call mark_messages_processed from the ingestion CLI
note: An earlier patch silently failed to match and was committed unverified; the filing pass was imported but never called. Root cause was not verifying the edit applied.

intent: Derive the extraction prompt's type list from the schema
note: Fix for the 4th instance of the drift class -- a value restated in two places that silently diverged.

intent: Warn instead of returning 0.0 silently on unpriced model/provider/tool-count
note: Six tests including the two negative cases. No defect surfaced in either later run.

intent: Record the effective model per run in the ledger
note: First implementation attempt inserted code into the wrong function via fragile index arithmetic; caught by a syntax check before commit and redone with anchored edits. In-flight error, not a shipped one.

intent: Rename repo and product name; update all references
note: Sweep matched only the full URL and long product-name forms, missing bare 'road-trip-generator'. Left README self-contradictory: clone itinerary-generator, then cd road-trip-generator. Surfaced while merging into TripTips.

intent: Point published-itinerary links at the site that serves them
note: Also found and fixed a pre-existing defect: the advertised Pages URLs had never existed.
Implemented as specified. Contributed to run 2's item-count growth, but that was stated in advance (the ceiling was measured as non-binding), so it is a known trade rather than a defect.

intent: Let a trail keep its AllTrails link when another category claims it
note: Impact measured before building (11 same-entity pairs, no false conflations).

intent: Refill emptied attraction slots from already-harvested trails
Correct grok pricing, split the discovery model, pass allowed_domains
note: Pricing correction worked. The model split silently never applied -- gated on the CONTENT provider being grok, but content runs on openai. A test was written that asserted the broken behaviour, which is the injected defect: it would have prevented the bug being noticed by test.

intent: Pass the itinerary's item names to the attraction batch to cut no_match
note: Plumbing worked; content was wrong. Hike names were sent to the attraction batch, whose prompt says 'excluding hikes'. no_match rose 82 -> 108.

intent: Resolve en-route stops to a Maps link instead of hunting a website
note: REVISED after run 3. Originally recorded clean-with-a-defect on the strength of direct_batch_candidate_rejected falling 301 -> 50. That headline was misleading: setting en_route_source to 'maps' also skipped the harvest that SUPPLIES en-route stops, so cards fell 50 -> 12 (76% content loss) and the geometry pass assigning route-verified geocodes collapsed 35 -> 9. Most of the 'improvement' was stops ceasing to exist. Also injected the coordinate-rewrite defect. Two separate errors in one change.

intent: Fix the model-split gate and the coordinate rewrite
note: Model split VERIFIED working: observed_models carries grok:grok-4.3 and token cost fell 37% ($5.36 -> $3.38). The coordinate fix could not take effect -- zero coordinate links were even BUILT, because the deeper en-route-maps bug had disabled the geocoding the coordinate path depends on. Correct fix, blocked by an unrelated defect underneath it.

intent: Route hike hints to the trail batch
note: Second consecutive failure on batch alignment. direct_batch_no_match went 108 -> 125, having already gone 82 -> 108. Routing hike names to the trail batch was correct in itself and did not help, so the model of the problem is wrong -- stop iterating and re-diagnose.

intent: Make maps mode change resolution only, not whether the harvest runs
note: Verified by run 4: the en-route harvest runs again (batches 28 -> 38 calls) and en-route stops are back. Cost +359k tokens, which is the content returning, not waste.

intent: Replace the paid per-item fallback with a free geocode; predicted -66%
note: Predicted fallback calls 218 -> ~0 and cost $5.85 -> ~$2.00. Actual: 156 calls survived and cost fell 6% to $5.48. Root cause is a wrong model of the target: 'url_discovery_fallback' is an operation PREFIX shared by four call paths, only one of which (_search_first_strict) is the per-item website hunt. Gating _search_first left the other three untouched. Separately injected a regression -- the gate applies to every _search_first caller but the geocode replacement was wired only for attractions, so restaurant removals went 2 -> 36. Attractions genuinely improved (29 -> 17 removed, 28 geocode links attached), so the mechanism works and the targeting does not. Reverted to fallback_mode: search pending a kind-aware gate.
